title: Robust-by-Design Distributional Learning from Contaminated Samples
abstract: arXiv:2610.40884v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern data analysis pipelines increasingly rely on large datasets assembled through retrieval, scraping, automated filtering, and post-hoc curation, where the observed sample is often a contaminated mixture rather than the target population. Standard distributional objectives either ignore contamination and converge to the wrong target, or retain only a small trusted subset and discard most of the data. We study supervised and unsupervised learning when a clean reference sample is compared with a pooled sample from $r=(1-\epsilon)q+\epsilon z$, where $q$ is the latent target distribution and $z$ is an unknown contaminant. translated_title: 从受污染样本中进行设计上稳健的分布学习
translated_abstract: 现代数据分析流程日益依赖于通过检索、抓取、自动过滤和事后整理构建的大型数据集，在这些场景下，观测到的样本往往是一个受污染的混合体，而非目标总体。标准的分布学习目标要么忽略污染并收敛到错误的目标，要么仅保留一个小的可信子集而丢弃大部分数据。我们研究有监督与无监督学习问题：将一个干净的参考样本与来自 $r=(1-\epsilon)q+\epsilon z$ 的混合样本进行比较，其中 $q$ 是潜在的目标分布，$z$ 是未知的污染物。受如下场景启发——所有观测都具有带噪声的成员资格分数，而一个小的已审计子集具有精确标签——我们提出了污染校正的最大均值差异（CC-MMD），这是一种基于设计的估计量，它将代理分数与已审计的残差校正相结合，以恢复本应得到的预言机 MMD（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出污染校正的最大均值差异估计量（CC-MMD），通过将带噪声的代理分数与小规模已审计子集的精确标签校正相结合，从受污染的混合样本中稳健地学习潜在的目标分布。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a contamination-corrected maximum mean discrepancy (CC-MMD) estimator that combines noisy proxy scores with audited residual corrections to robustly learn the latent target distribution from contaminated pooled samples.
